recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, high-contrast holiday composition featuring a central vertical stack of hand-drawn characters and a decorated tree against a stark white background, framed by a solid red border.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical hierarchy from small top character to wide base group
Primary color blocking (red, green, blue) against neutral white
Hand-drawn organic line art contrasted with rigid geometric typography
Symmetrical balance anchored by a central vertical axis
coreInvariants: Black ink outlines of uniform weight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical column occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The base group of three characters providing a wide foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the header text, through the character on top, down the tree to the base group.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central illustration to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary and secondary colors with no gradients or shading.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric grotesque forms

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by white space above the illustration

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and colors for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, mid-century aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary visual weight and blocky presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat white square canvas with a thick solid red border. In the center, place a hand-drawn, ink-outlined Christmas tree with simple colorful ornaments. At the base of the tree, place three stylized cartoon children in flat-colored winter clothes. On top of the tree, place a small white cartoon dog.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a bold geometric sans-serif font, add centered all-caps text at the top. Use dark blue for the top line, green for the middle lines, and red for the bottom lines. Maintain tight leading and tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the border a consistent solid red?
Are the colors flat without gradients?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is touching the illustration
Check that the red border is perfectly aligned to the edges
Verify that the ink outlines are consistent in weight
Confirm all colors are solid fills
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized vertical stack + stark white negative space + bold geometric sans-serif + primary color palette + solid frame border.
